reviewEvidence: Candidate checkout is clean at the exact reviewed SHA; diff check passes. The test-file SHA-256 matches the 149-entry source manifest.
The existing 23 delivery-effects tests and subtests remain; one isolation regression raises the file total to 24. Root combined gates ran 151 tests with 151 passing, all 14 commands exiting zero.

One file-scoped PGlite engine executes migrations 001 through 008 once. A promise queue grants one fixture at a time; setup failure releases its queue slot, every current test closes in a finally block, and the file after hook waits for the queue then closes the engine.

Before a later fixture is granted, TRUNCATE covers every migration-created public table with RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE. A pg_tables inventory rejects any newly created public table missing from the reset list. The migration-002 governor lock row is restored and asserted after each reset.

Counters, simulated remote state, SQL transaction lock, and other mutable test doubles are constructed inside each setup.
